2608.24460.title: Shortcut Before Circuit: Document Statistics Time In-Context Conflict Resolution
2608.24460.paper_summary: When a context asserts two values for one fact, a model commits to a cue -- recency, repetition, position -- but natural data rarely makes these disagree, so behavior cannot reveal which. We train 26M-parameter transformers on a synthetic language where recency and rarity are exactly coextensive, and separate them with a minimal causal edit that inverts one cue while holding the truth, token count and answer position fixed. All 75 runs reach accuracy >= 0.999, including where the trivial heuristic fails, so no held-in evaluation distinguishes them. Under intervention the per-cell readout does not replicate: 13 of 25 cells differ by more than 0.3 in sign fraction across three seeds, the largest by 0.879 against a standard error of 0.025. The construction predicts this -- coextensive rules leave the objective indifferent between them -- and the variance is ordered by how much of the optimization each comparison releases. What replicates is timing: escape from a positional shortcut with a closed-form ceiling, monotone in redundancy. Probed before that escape, attribution reverses sign in 32 of 75 runs at unchanged accuracy, and gating on circuit formation is necessary but not sufficient. The corpus fixes when a mechanism appears, not which one -- a criterion for when mechanistic attribution to data is available at all, and our construction makes the unavailable case exact.
2608.24460.paper_summary_zh: 當一個上下文對一個事實聲明兩個值時，模型會依賴一個提示——最近性、重複性、位置——但自然數據很少使這些相互矛盾，因此行為無法揭示哪一種。<lb/>我們在一種合成語言上訓練了26M參數的Transformer，其中最近性和稀有性是完全共存的，並通過一個最小的因果編輯將它們分開，該編輯在保持真實性、標記數量和答案位置不變的情況下反轉了一個提示。<lb/>所有75次運行的準確率均達到>= 0.999，包括在簡單啟發式失敗的情況下，因此沒有持有的評估能夠區分它們。<lb/>在干預下，每個單元的讀出並不重複：在三個種子中，25個單元中有13個的符號分數差異超過0.3，最大差異為0.879，標準誤差為0.025。<lb/>該結構預測了這一點——共存規則使客觀性對它們無所謂——而方差的排序則取決於每次比較釋放了多少優化。<lb/>重複的是時機：逃離具有封閉形式上限的位置信息捷徑，在冗餘中單調。<lb/>在逃離之前進行探測時，歸因在75次運行中的32次反轉符號，準確率不變，並且在電路形成中的閘控是必要但不充分的。<lb/>語料庫確定了機制出現的時間，而不是哪一個——這是一個判斷何時可以對數據進行機械歸因的標準，而我們的結構使得不可用的情況變得精確。
2608.24460.author: Yijun Liao et.al.
